logging/named#

Named loggers with their clock, fixed fields and process id; Logger is the short form.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let shop = NamedLogging(name: LogName("shop"), destination: TextStreamLogs(Stderr()));
shop.log(LogLevel.info, "started");
shop.child("db").log(LogLevel.debug, "pool ready");

Description#

Named loggers with their clock, fixed fields and process id; Logger is the short form.

A logger with its name, destination, clock, fields and process.

NamedLogging.NamedLogging#

NamedLogging(name is string, destination is LogWriting, clock is Timing = SystemClock(), fields is LogFields = LogFields())

The common case: NamedLogging(name: "shop", destination: logs). The clock is the system's and no fields are added unless given.

NamedLogging.NamedLogging#

A logger called name, writing to destination, with clock and fields.
